coaching.headline: 14-1 in 11 minutes — three fights, all won, Mini Prime and Fangtooth banked off the last two.
coaching.team: Short and clean: 3-0 at 2.4 in their river, then 2-0s at 9.9 and 10.8 that cashed straight into Mini Prime and Fangtooth. Nobody on our side was caught out once. The only note for a longer game: the opening 3-0 converted nothing, and the comp carried no healer — against a team that doesn't fold by 11 minutes, those margins get tested.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 9.9 and 10.8 picks — two kills each at our Mini Prime and our Fangtooth — turned a kill lead into the objective lead that ended it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase went 0/0/5 — attached, alive, and on the assist for half the team's kills in 11 minutes. Nothing to fix at this length; the Crescelia opener was the only item the game allowed.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow went 6/0/1 into a lane that read Skylar's on paper — the scoreboard overruled it. Both game-ending picks (9.9, 10.8) had Sparrow at the center, and zero deaths is the line of the match.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult

ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
ourKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
ourKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
ourKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down

ourKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
ourKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
